A closer look

DEVELOPER WORKSPACE UTILITY
01 /

Review before you clean.

Scan selected development projects, review supported cache candidates, and use a read-only preview before confirming a move to the Trash.

02 /

Keep track of your changes.

Use ignore lists and operation history. The restore flow checks file identity and skips items it cannot safely verify.

03 /

See what is running.

Inspect port usage and confirm before ending a process owned by your user. Menu-bar monitoring keeps system information close at hand.

GET STARTED

Try the macOS release.

The release page includes DMG and ZIP packages. Read the release notes and check compatibility before installing.

KeepBuild v0.2.0

macOS 14 or later. Public distribution packages are available on GitHub.

View releases & downloads

A few useful details.

Does cleanup permanently delete files?

The documented cleanup flow moves confirmed items to the system Trash. It does not empty the Trash. Moving files there does not immediately free disk space.

Does it scan my whole Mac?

The documented project cleanup workflow scans selected projects using supported rules. It is not a promise of system-wide or automatic cleanup.

Is KeepBuild open source?

The release repository is public, but the application source repository is currently private. Public downloads and open source are different availability states.
